main_text.p: peribus succurrere. Chald. בִּצְדָקָה Justitiâ, Dan.4.24. Constr. צִדְקַת Ezech.18.26. Aff. צִדְקָתוֹ Justitiam ejus, Psal.22.32. Plural. עֲשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת Exercens justitias, Psal.103.6. Constr. צִדְקוֹת Mich.6.5. Aff. צִדְקוֹתֵינוּ Justitia nostra, Jesa.64.6.
main_text.head: צָהֹב
main_text.p: צָהוֹב m. Fulvus, Fulgens, Levit.13.30. Jonathan, Splendens ut aurum. Nam convenit cum זָהָב, commutatis ז & צ, ut in עָלֵז & עָלֵץ. Hoph. Praeter. מְצֻהָב Fulgens, Esr.8.27.
main_text.head: צָהַל
main_text.p: Hinnivit: Verbum Equorum proprium, ex laetitia & lascivia hinnientium: Metaphoricè Hominibus tribuitur, pro, Claram, Laetam vocem edere, Jubilare: Praeter. צָהֲלוּ Hinnient, Jesa.24.14. צָהֲלָה Jubilabat, Esth.8.15. Impet. צַהֲלוּ Jubilate. Jerem.31.7. צַהֲלִי קוֹלֵךְ Clarâm ede vocem tuam, Jesa.10.30. Futur. אֶל אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ יִצְהֲלוּ Ad uxorem proximi sui adhinniunt, Jer.5.8. Hiph. Infin. לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים Laetam efficiendo faciem, Psal.104.15.
מְצַהֲלוֹת f.p. Hinnitus: Constr. מְקוֹל מְצַהֲלוֹת אַבִּירָיו A sono hinnituum robustorum ejus, Jer.8.16. Aff. וּמְצַהֲלוֹתֶיךָ Et hinnitus tui, Jerem.13.27.
main_text.head: צָהַר
main_text.p: צֹהַר m. Lumen, Splendor, Fenestra, Genes.6. v.16. sic dicta, quòd Lucem transmittit. Verbum צָהַר Lucere, Chaldaïs usitatum est.
main_text.head: צָהֳרַיִם
main_text.p: m.d. Meridies, quia diem in duas partes æquas dividit, & gemina lucis, antemeridiana & vespertina, medium est interstitium & terminus. Est autem formæ אָזְנַיִם, ac proinde primum Kametz est breve: בְּעֵת צָהֳרַיִם Tempore meridiano, Jerem.20.16. בַּצָּהֳרַיִם In meridie, Genes.43.16.
main_text.head: יִצְהָר
main_text.p: m. Oleum, à pellucido colore, 2.Reg.18.32. Aff. וְיִצְהָרֵיךָ Et oleum tuum, Deut.7.13.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords (צהב, צהל, צהר, צהרים, יצהר) stand large in the left margin; they are rendered here as level-2 heads. Hebrew vowel points in the entries are faint and hard to read at this scan resolution, so the pointing is approximate and may need checking against a clean copy. Several Hebrew forms in the Hinnient/Jubilate and Aff. lines are not certain; no [?] was added because the forms are reconstructed from the printed Latin glosses rather than read letter by letter. The Greek-letter cross-references and the 'Chald.' Hebrew forms in the first line should be verified. The running head is Hebrew and printed centred at the top.
